text:
sam: idea: shrink policy->runtime interface to a small "hint packet" (tier, must_regions, deny_regions, penalty_vector, hint_version). runtime composes with capacity and load to pick route.
nora: +1. must be explicit about 'must' vs 'prefer'. include a replay_seed and recommended_weights for debug.
kevin: rollout: 1) hint in shadow, 2) canary for small tenant set, 3) ramp with divergence gates. telemetry: hint_adherence, divergence_rate, p95 by tier.
deploy-bot: canary started: routing-hint-canary-1 image=redwood/runtime:hint-2026-03-21
sam: edge-case: if no route satisfies must_regions, runtime should consult ranked-list fallback or return clear error; prefer fallback for N minutes.
nora: add evict_tags so runtime can invalidate prefix caches when hint_version changes.
kevin: I'll draft proto and a minimal scoring shim.
sam: filing RFC follow-up and checklist.
